answer.summary: Investigate the variation of the fidelity score over 50 update intervals under a 100-token budget with periodic input and known perturbations as reported in Section 6.1 of Wang et al., 2024.
answer.content: This investigation focuses exclusively on the experimentally reported fidelity score in Wang et al., 2024, Section 6.1, examining its behavior across 50 update intervals under bounded token constraints and known perturbations. The analysis will verify the metric's consistency and reported trends without extrapolation or inference beyond the data provided. Acceptance criteria require direct citation of the fidelity score and explicit alignment with the reported experimental conditions and outcomes in the source material. No indirect or derived metrics are permitted.
